WITH date_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998) AS start_1998,
        (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998) AS end_1998,
        (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) AS start_1999,
        (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) AS end_1999
),
store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        's' AS sale_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1998 AND dr.end_1998 THEN ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS store_1998,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1999 AND dr.end_1999 THEN ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS store_1999
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_ranges dr
      ON (ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1998 AND dr.end_1998)
      OR (ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1999 AND dr.end_1999)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
),
web_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        'w' AS sale_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1998 AND dr.end_1998 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS web_1998,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1999 AND dr.end_1999 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS web_1999
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_ranges dr
      ON (ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1998 AND dr.end_1998)
      OR (ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN dr.start_1999 AND dr.end_1999)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM store_totals s
JOIN web_totals w ON s.ss_customer_sk = w.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk
WHERE s.sale_type = 's'
  AND w.sale_type = 'w'
  AND s.store_1998 > 0
  AND w.web_1998 > 0
  AND s.store_1999 IS NOT NULL
  AND w.web_1999 IS NOT NULL
  AND (w.web_1999 / w.web_1998) > (s.store_1999 / s.store_1998)
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_email_address
LIMIT 100

3. 5. GUARDED-RATIO SIMPLIFICATION — TARGET: final `case when ... then t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total ...` comparison — TRANSFORMATION: after enforcing `store_1998 > 0`, `web_1998 > 0`, `store_1999 IS NOT NULL`, `web_1999 IS NOT NULL` on the pivoted row, compare the two year-total ratios directly without the `CASE` guards, since the first-year totals are already known positive.
